{{Quote|You'll note it has the same texture and color pattern as your official bowlcarrier vest. Once secured there, it will be invisible to even the most strong-eyed observer.|Jirvin|translated=1|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''bowlcarrier vest''' was a [[Clothing/Legends|vest]] worn by the [[bowlcarrier]], an individual tasked with carrying a bowl of [[Nectar/Legends|nectar]] for the reigning the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]. The piece of clothing was textured and had a color pattern.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Trevik]], the bowlcarrier of the ruling [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]] of the [[Red City]], inserted a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]] given to him by his [[Trevik's family|brother]] [[Jirvin]] in [[Gender/Legends|his]] vest to record the paintings brought to the [[Dwelling of Guests]] building by the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]. After returning the cam to Jirvin, the recordings were sent to [[Empire of the Hand]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], who strategized as Esva desired. While recording the artwork inside the dwelling, no one noticed the cam, as Trevik's [[Trevik's family|brother]] [[Jirvin]], had anticipated.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The vest appeared in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
